Name: Pet Sounds for Other Mods
Author: DarkSylux315
Description:
[size=3]This is a simple dog/cat sound replacement mod to use in conjunction with other pre-existing pet mods. 
I have tried a lot of different mods that change the pet sprite into something new, notably the Pokémon ones, and I love the variety of options.  However, I just couldn't get over the fact that my Dratini was meowing at me (lol) so I decided to replace the pet sound files to help maintain the thin veil of immersion in my game.


This mod includes the wave bank files that contain the appropriate sounds to complement the following mods:[/size]

All of these replace the sounds for either both the dog and cat unless I specify otherwise, so you only have to pick one file for the mod you're using.

[size=4][color=#cc0000][b]*If you have previously downloaded any of these files (before I added the v1.x to each file name), it is [u]highly[/u] recommended that you install the updated version as I have fixed a small issue that was in EVERY file.[/b][/color]
[color=#6fa8dc]**All of these sound replacements are now compatible with Stardew Valley 1.2 and 1.3 beta.  These also work in multiplayer, but the sounds are only changed for the person that installed them.  If there are any issues please let me know.[/color][/size]



[size=3]~~ INSTALLATION ~~

1.  Extract the Wave Bank.xwb from the ZIP you downloaded.

2.  From your main Stardew Valley folder, go to Content\XACT.

3.  (Recommended) Backup your original Wave Bank.xwb file.

4.  Paste/drag the extracted xwb file into this folder and overwrite the original.

5.  Enjoy!

>To remove this mod just replace the Wave Bank file with the original one you backed up.

[/size][b][size=3]*Please note that these sound files are probably not compatible with other mods that change audio.[/size]
[/b]


[size=2]Disclaimer: The crow and junimo sounds are from the Stardew game files and the Pokémon cries were taken from PokémonCries.com and Veekun.com.
[/size]

[size=3][u]If there are any other sounds you would like me to add or any custom sound combinations you want, feel free to leave a comment.[/u]
[/size]

[size=2]This is my first mod so please let me know what you think![/size]

[size=3]Thank you for checking out my page and many thanks to the awesome people that created the other pet mods![/size]
